title: 第三百五十二章 天乐赠礼第三百五十一章 连哄带骗
lines: 第两百五十二章：天乐赠礼
当叶重说到严苛带着属下，在苍狼山深处历经千辛万苦，经历九死一生的搏杀，为大汉朝终于带回来了三块珍贵的黑石碑的事情时，叶重是格外的进行了艺术加工，把严苛描述成了一个高大全近乎完美的大汉儿郎。
其中，严苛在苍狼山中碰到的那些凶险，更是被叶重描述得波澜壮阔犹如好莱坞的大片。使得天乐公主听得入了神，不由得朝严苛点了点头：“你就是严苛？是个好人呢，本宫下次和父王说说，给你封个大将军吧。”。
严苛骤然一呆，半天没反应过来。叶重这么一通胡诌，他自己都听得脸红了，居然就能忽悠天乐公主许诺他一个大将军的军职？齐天君最宠爱天乐公主不过，如果她开口，说不定这事情还真成了。
月上中天，时值深夜，喝得有七八分醉意的天乐必须要回宫了。当着众多侍女护卫的面，天乐公主一路拉着叶重的手走出了刘乐公府。她一路嘻嘻哈哈的笑着，无比的欢乐。
在刘乐公府门前，天乐公主挽着叶重的手，笑吟吟的对他许诺道：“叶重，你现在是本宫最好的朋友哩。本宫有时候必须做修炼的功夫，不能经常来找你，有空你来天乐苑或者皇宫里探望本宫吧。”。
伸手从脖子上解下了一块椭圆形的碧绿色美玉，天乐公主将这块贴身的美玉系在了叶重的脖子上。这等亲昵的行径，顿时看傻了附近的宫禁卫。朱易和严苛更是呆滞犹如木头，天乐公主的贴身玉佩啊，就这样送给了叶重？
毕竟，这可是天乐公主的贴身之物啊！
叶重径直从储物锦囊中掏出了那颗三千八百年的天水灵蛇丹递给了天乐公主。
“叶重身无长物，只有这颗灵兽内丹是叶重平日修炼所用，今日就赠送给公主！”
天乐公主呆呆的看着叶重手上晶莹剔透宛如蓝宝石的天水灵蛇丹，突然嫣然一笑，将它一把握在了手中。眼波流转，天乐公主斜睨了叶重一眼，轻笑道：“算你呢，这颗内丹，天乐很喜欢啊！”。
红唇凑到叶重耳朵边，天乐公主轻声说道：“记住，天乐的名字，是天乐。”。
冉冉上了车驾，在众多护卫的簇拥下，天乐公主刘天乐飘然远去。而叶重则是深吸了一口气，背着双手，望着天空一轮明月，突然幽幽的叹息了一声：“公子，我突然很有罪恶感。”。
朱易和严苛相互望了一眼，一起点了点头。晨露湿润了长安的街道，朦胧的白气在大街小巷内飘荡。
骑着独角麋鹿，叶重领着一众随从回到了刘乐公府。一大清早的，他就带着朱易的授权公文跑遍了长安七个和封地有关的衙门，好容易才帮虞玄获取了上将军荆轲悬赏的那一个郡的封地。
上将军的悬赏，那是铁板钉钉没有丝毫纰漏的。一郡之地的封地，很惹人红眼，但是错非虞玄这样的权贵，换了以前的朱易，他得到这一郡之地不见得是福气。也许他得到封地的第二天，就会和他的亲生父亲一样，莫名其妙的坠江溺毙。
就算是现在的刘乐公朱易，他如果莫名其妙的多了一大块封地，肯定会受到其他各宗权贵的嫉妒。这对朱易在大汉朝的发展，可不是什么好事情。就让位高权重的虞玄，去承受这个麻烦吧。再说了，没有这块封地做酬劳，朱易现在能否继承刘乐公的爵位还是个问题呢。
现在好了，这块封地总算是用各种借口转移到了虞玄的手上。麻烦没有了，朱易安安稳稳的坐在了刘乐公的位置上，还获得了以虞玄为代表的大汉朝一众国老的友谊，朱易的根基又扎实了许久。
蹄声清脆，叶重在刘乐公府门前下了坐骑，在几个门房的殷勤招呼下踏上了台阶。
扯下身上沾满露水的斗篷递给一个随行的护卫，叶重正要进门，不远处的一条小巷里，突然有一架华贵的车驾行了出来，天乐公主的一个随身侍女从车里探出头来，清脆的朝这边叫了一声：“叶重先生！”。
愣了愣，叶重急忙迎了上去，很是雍容朝那侍女行了一礼：“原来是白鸽姑娘，来找叶重不知有何贵干？”。
天乐公主的两个随身侍女，一个叫做白鸽，就是眼前的这位，生得苗条伶俐，也是个天生的美人坯子。另外一个叫做紫鸢，体态丰腴圆润，性格娇憨，更带着点傻乎乎的劲头。两人之中，平日里负责给天乐公主处理各项事务的，还是这个伶俐聪明的白鸽。
掩嘴轻笑了几声，白鸽压低了声音笑道：“有事呢。”。
眼波流转，朝四周看了看，喝退了几个紧随在车驾边的宫禁卫，白鸽低声笑道：“公主今天一大早起来，就叫人去天乐苑，要把天乐苑里面所有的湖泊河流里面种满水莲花。叶重先生，你可给宫里的管事们添了不小的麻烦。嘻嘻，天乐苑里的湖泊河流可老不少！”。
叶重干笑了一声，昨天被逼无奈，对天乐公主一个小丫头片子使出了那种手段，弄得那小丫头一怔一怔的，实在不是什么好汉子的行为。只不过天乐公主居然牢牢记住了叶重送他的那朵水莲花，要把天乐苑所有的水系里种满水莲，这让叶重也有点瞠目结舌无法言语。
白鸽朝叶重挤了挤眼睛，她在袖子里摸了摸，取出了一粒暗金色的精致戒指递给了叶重。这戒指很是精巧，主体呈暗金色，上面镶嵌了九粒芝麻粒大小的幽蓝色宝石。随着白鸽手指的动作，戒指通体荡漾出一层淡淡的光晕，美轮美奂，尊贵神秘到了极点。
“公主说了，叶重先生用的还是一个下下品的储物锦囊呢。正好公主有一粒多出来的储物戒指，品质还可以，要先生不要嫌弃，先将就用着。戒指里的东西，也是这些年皇上和大王赏赐给公主的，公主用不着，先生留着玩耍也好。”
抓过叶重的手，将戒指塞进了叶重的掌心，白鸽又说道：“公主的修炼到了紧要关头，每隔半个月必须入定一次。短的话就两三天能出关，长的话一次调息说不定就要两三个月，公主自己也不知道一次入定需要的时间。总之公主如果出关了，就会来找先生，先生不要挂念就好。”。
歪着脑袋看了看呆呆愣愣的叶重，白鸽用力拍了一下自己的额头，嬉笑道：“差点忘了。”。
伸手在另外一只袖子里掏摸了一阵，白鸽掏出了一块巴掌大小的青黑色令牌，不容分说的塞进了叶重手中。“这是公主能拿到的，长安权限最高的七刘禁牌。有了这禁牌，先生夜间可以随意出入内城，白天可以随意进宫，除了几处禁地秘宫，别的地方都通行无阻。”。
喘了一口气，白鸽继续说道：“这禁牌权力极大，公主只为先生报备了，千万不能落入其他人手中。”。
匆匆的嘱咐了叶重一通，白鸽惦记着又一次闭关入定的天乐公主，忙不迭的催促着随行人等送她回转皇宫。叶重拿了一粒储物戒指，一块禁牌，半晌说不出话来。
禁牌，这是大汉朝的特权令牌。禁牌通体青黑色，这也是大汉朝的权贵最喜欢的颜色，更是大汉朝大臣的朝服颜色。禁牌上有风卷流云花纹，风云之中有飞鸟翱翔。
由此可见天乐公主在长安的滔天权势，也能看出她对叶重的那一份古怪的情谊。
咧了咧嘴，叶重将禁牌仔细的把玩了一通，将它塞进了储物戒指。他苦笑道：“我怎么沦落到用小金鱼诱骗小女孩的地步了？几句抄袭的话语，一点点心机，就能勾搭一个天潢贵胄，我是运气太好呢？还是运气太差呢？”。
苦笑几声，叶重将一滴血滴上了储物戒指，又将一缕灵识烙印在了戒指上，顺利的接管了这个戒指的所有权。他的灵识透入戒指，顿时被里面庞大的空间吓了一大跳。
天乐公主送叶重的这枚储物戒指，却是长宽百丈，高也在百丈左右，这简直就是一栋摩天大楼的储存量。巨大的空间显得有点空荡荡的，几口硕大的青铜箱子漂浮在半空中，正散发出若有若无的灵气波动。
叶重灵识扫过青铜箱子，不由得咧了咧嘴。这些箱子长宽六尺，高三尺左右，箱盖上雕刻了‘大汉内库’的字样，从下面的铭牌标记可以看出，这些箱子都是大汉朝战略储备仓库里的存货，却被天乐公主拎了出来做人情。
一共八口箱子，里面码放着清一色打磨工整，足足有成年人拳头大小的上品水属性灵石。所有的灵石都是一水儿的幽蓝色，光芒熠熠宛如最深邃的海洋的颜色，蕴藏着极其强大的水属性灵气。
八口箱子里的上品水属性灵石加起来，怕不是有十万块左右？
这可是大汉朝内库的战略储备灵石，天知道天乐公主怎么从内库中提取出来，又怎么从账本上抹除了这些灵石的痕迹。叶重反正是只觉得头皮一阵发麻，深为天乐公主的胆大包天感到钦佩无比。
“我怎么觉得，我变成了小白那个常年吃软饭的家伙？”
自嘲的摇了摇头，叶重的灵识扫向了八口青铜箱子一旁的数十个寒玉药瓶。药瓶上都有标志，分明雕刻了‘真水沄澜丹’五个大字。一共是三十六个药瓶，每个药瓶中都有十二粒鸽子蛋大小，呈半透明的碧蓝色，散发出强大水属性波动的灵丹。

Chapter 252: Tianle’s gift
When Ye Zhong talked about how Yan Yan and his subordinates went through untold hardships in the depths of Canglang Mountain and fought almost to death to finally bring back three precious black stone tablets for the Han Dynasty, Ye Zhong went to great lengths to perform artistic processing, describing Yan Yan as a tall and almost perfect man.
Among them, the dangers that Yan Yan encountered in Canglang Mountain were described by Ye Zhong as magnificent as a Hollywood blockbuster. Princess Tianle listened in rapt attention and couldn't help but nod to Yan Yan: "Are you Yan Yan? You are a good person. I will talk to my father next time and make you a general."
Yan Yan was stunned suddenly and didn't react for a long time. Ye Chong made such nonsense, he even blushed. How could he fool Princess Tianle into promising him a military position as a general? Qi Tianjun loves Princess Tianle the most, but if she opens her mouth, maybe this matter will actually happen.
The moon was at the top of the sky, it was late at night, and Tianle, who was 70 to 80% drunk, had to go back to the palace. In front of many maids and guards, Princess Tianle held Ye Zhong's hand and walked out of Liu Legong's mansion. She was laughing and joking all the way, extremely happy.
In front of Liu Legong's mansion, Princess Tianle held Ye Zhong's hand and promised him with a smile: "Ye Chong, you are my best friend now. Sometimes I have to do some cultivation and can't come to you often. When you have time, come to Tianle Garden or visit me in the palace."
Reaching out and unhooking a piece of oval-shaped turquoise jade from her neck, Princess Tianle tied the close-fitting piece of jade around Ye Zhong's neck. This kind of intimate behavior immediately stunned the nearby palace guards. Zhu Yi and Yan Yan were as dull as wood. Princess Tianle's personal jade pendant was given to Ye Zhong like this?
After all, this is Princess Tianle’s personal belongings!
Ye Zhong took out the 3,800-year-old Tianshui Spirit Snake Pill from his storage bag and handed it to Princess Tianle.
"Ye Chong has nothing in his body, only this spirit beast inner elixir is used by Ye Chong for daily practice. I will give it to the princess today!"
Princess Tianle stared blankly at the crystal clear sapphire-like Tianshui Spirit Snake Pill in Ye Zhong's hand. She suddenly smiled and took it in her hand. With her eyes turning, Princess Tianle glanced sideways at Ye Zhong and chuckled, "What about you? Tianle likes this inner elixir very much!".
With her red lips close to Ye Zhong's ear, Princess Tianle said softly: "Remember, Tianle's name is Tianle.".
Slowly getting into the car, surrounded by many guards, Princess Tianle Liu Tianle drifted away. Ye Zhong took a deep breath, clasped his hands behind his back, looked at the bright moon in the sky, and suddenly sighed faintly: "Master, I suddenly feel very guilty.".
Zhu Yi and Yan Yan looked at each other and nodded together. Morning dew moistened the streets of Chang'an, and a hazy white air floated in the streets and alleys.
Riding a one-horned elk, Ye Zhong led a group of followers back to Liu Legong's mansion. Early in the morning, he took Zhu Yi's official authorization document and visited the seven fiefdom-related yamen in Chang'an, and finally helped Yu Xuan obtain the fiefdom in the county where General Jing Ke offered a reward.
The general's reward is absolutely flawless. The fiefdom of a county is very eye-catching, but for a powerful man like Yu Xuan, if it were Zhu Yi, it would not necessarily be a blessing for him to get the land of this county. Maybe the day after he got the fief, he would fall into the river and drown inexplicably like his biological father.
Even if it is the current Liu Legong Zhu Yi, if he inexplicably gains a large fiefdom, he will definitely be jealous of other powerful people. This is not a good thing for Zhu Yi's development in the Han Dynasty. Let Yu Xuan, who is in a high position, bear this trouble. Besides, without this fiefdom as a reward, it is still a question whether Zhu Yi can inherit Liu Legong's title.
Now, this fiefdom was finally transferred to Yu Xuan's hands using various excuses. The trouble was gone, Zhu Yi'an sat firmly in Liu Legong's position, and also gained the friendship of the elders of the Han Dynasty represented by Yu Xuan. Zhu Yi's foundation was solid for a long time.
With the crisp sound of hoofbeats, Ye Zhong got off his mount in front of Liu Legong's mansion and stepped onto the steps with the attentive greetings of several concierges.
He pulled off his dew-stained cloak and handed it to an accompanying guard. Just as Ye Zhong was about to enter, a luxurious car suddenly drove out of an alley not far away. One of Princess Tianle's maids poked her head out of the car and called out crisply: "Mr. Ye Zhong!"
After being stunned for a moment, Ye Zhong hurriedly greeted her and saluted the maid gracefully: "It turns out to be Miss Baige. Why do you want to come to Ye Zhong?"
Princess Tianle's two maids, one is called Baige, the one in front of her is slim, smart, and a natural beauty. The other one is called Ziyuan, with a plump and round body, a charming and naive personality, and a bit of silly energy. Among the two, the one who is responsible for handling various affairs for Princess Tianle on weekdays is still this clever white pigeon.
Covering her mouth and chuckling a few times, Bai Ge lowered her voice and said with a smile: "Something's wrong.".
With his eyes wandering, he looked around and dismissed a few palace guards who were following the car. Baige laughed softly and said, "The princess got up early this morning and sent people to Tianle Garden to plant all the lakes and rivers in Tianle Garden with water lotuses. Mr. Ye Chong, you have caused a lot of trouble for the palace stewards. Hehe, the lakes and rivers in Tianle Garden are quite old!"
Ye Chongqian laughed. He was forced to do that to a little girl, Princess Tianle, yesterday. It made the little girl stunned. It was really not the behavior of a good man. However, Princess Tianle actually remembered the water lotus that Ye Zhong gave him and wanted to plant all the water lilies in Tianle Garden. This made Ye Zhong a little stunned and speechless.
Bai Ge winked at Ye Chong. She touched in her sleeves and took out a dark gold delicate ring and handed it to Ye Chong. This ring is very delicate, the main body is dark gold, and it is inlaid with nine sesame-sized blue gems. Following the movements of the white dove's fingers, a faint halo of light rippled across the ring. It was beautiful, noble and mysterious to the extreme.
"Princess said, Mr. Ye Zhong is still using a low-grade storage bag. It just so happens that the princess has an extra storage ring. The quality is not bad. Please don't dislike it and use it first. The things in the ring are also gifts given to the princess by the emperor and the king over the years. If the princess doesn't need it, you can keep it for fun."
Grabbing Ye Zhong's hand and stuffing the ring into Ye Zhong's palm, Bai Ge added: "The princess's cultivation has reached a critical juncture, and she must enter trance every half month. If it's short, it only takes two or three days to get out of seclusion. If it's long, it may take two or three months to adjust her breath. The princess herself doesn't know how long it takes to enter trance. In short, if the princess gets out of seclusion, she will come to see the husband. Just don't worry about him."
Tilting his head and looking at Ye Zhong, who was stunned, Bai Ge forcefully slapped his forehead and said with a smile, "I almost forgot.".
After rummaging around in the other sleeve for a while, Bai Ge took out a palm-sized blue-black token and stuffed it into Ye Zhong's hand without any explanation. "This is the Qi Liu forbidden card with the highest authority in Chang'an that the princess can obtain. With this forbidden card, sir, you can enter and leave the inner city at will at night, and enter the palace at will during the day. Except for a few forbidden places and secret palaces, everything else can be accessed without hindrance."
After taking a breath, Baige continued: "This forbidden card power is extremely powerful. The princess only reported it for her husband. It must not fall into the hands of others.".
After hurriedly giving instructions to Ye Zhong, Bai Ge was thinking about Princess Tianle who was in seclusion again, and hurriedly urged her entourage to send her back to the palace. Ye Chong took a storage ring and a forbidden card, and was speechless for a long time.
Ban card, this is the privileged token of the Han Dynasty. The forbidden card is all blue and black, which was also the favorite color of the dignitaries of the Han Dynasty, and it was also the color of the court uniforms of the ministers of the Han Dynasty. There are patterns of wind and flowing clouds on the forbidden sign, and there are birds soaring in the wind and clouds.
This shows Princess Tianle's immense power in Chang'an, as well as her strange friendship for Ye Chong.
Grinning, Ye Zhong played with the forbidden card carefully and stuffed it into the storage ring. He smiled bitterly and said: "How did I end up deceiving a little girl with a little goldfish? With a few plagiarized words and a little bit of scheming, I can seduce a noble man. Am I very lucky? Or am I very unlucky?"
With a few wry smiles, Ye Zhong put a drop of blood on the storage ring, and imprinted a ray of spiritual consciousness on the ring, successfully taking over the ownership of the ring. His spiritual consciousness penetrated the ring, and he was immediately startled by the huge space inside.
The storage ring that Princess Tianle gave to Ye Zhong was a hundred feet long, one hundred feet wide, and about one hundred feet high. This was simply the storage capacity of a skyscraper. The huge space seemed a bit empty, with several large bronze boxes floating in the air, emitting faint fluctuations of spiritual energy.
Ye Chong's spiritual consciousness swept across the bronze box and he couldn't help but grin. These boxes are six feet long and wide and about three feet high. The words "Han Neiku" are engraved on the lids. From the nameplate mark below, it can be seen that these boxes are all inventory in the strategic reserve warehouse of the Han Dynasty, but Princess Tianle took them out as a favor.
There are eight boxes in total, and inside are stacked neatly polished high-grade water-attribute spiritual stones that are the size of an adult's fist. All the spirit stones are a faint blue, shining like the color of the deepest ocean, and contain extremely powerful water-attribute aura.
The total number of high-grade water-attribute spiritual stones in the eight boxes is probably around 100,000 yuan?
These are the strategic reserve spirit stones of the Han Dynasty. God knows how Princess Tianle extracted them from the inner treasury, and how she erased the traces of these spirit stones from the ledger. Anyway, Ye Chong only felt his scalp tingling, and he was deeply impressed by Princess Tianle's boldness.
"Why do I feel like I've become that guy like Xiaobai who eats soft food all the time?"
Shaking his head mockingly, Ye Zhong's spiritual consciousness scanned the dozens of cold jade medicine bottles beside the eight-port bronze box. There are signs on the medicine bottles, and the five characters "Zhen Shui Yuan Lan Dan" are clearly engraved on them. There are a total of thirty-six medicine bottles, each of which is about the size of twelve pigeon eggs. They are translucent blue and emit powerful elixirs with water properties.
